title: Su Qingyao Appears
next_chapter_hook: Just as Chen Ji's mental defenses were about to collapse, Su Qingyao took a broken jade pendant from her sleeve—the warm touch froze him in place, because on the back of the pendant was carved a name all too familiar to him.

text.content: Just as Chen Ji was about to give up, the will fluctuation from the depths of the Tianji Record grew increasingly clear, as if an invisible hand was pulling him toward a corner he had never noticed. His divine sense followed that pull deeper, yet he sensed an aura so familiar it chilled him—it was the Tianji Record's own aura, yet not quite the same, like some higher-dimensional projection.

At that moment, the prohibition deep within the ruins suddenly rippled. Chen Ji's pupils constricted—not from danger, but because he saw someone who shouldn't be here. Su Qingyao, the Inner Disciple Senior Fellow of the Tianqing Sect, the person who had been secretly investigating his true identity for three years, was slowly stepping out from those ripples.

dialogue.content: "Chen Ji, I've been looking for you for three years." Su Qingyao's voice was terrifyingly calm, yet hidden in her gaze toward Chen Ji was some indescribably complex emotion. "Did you think you could hide from me forever?"

text.content: Chen Ji quickly gathered his composure, a habitual timid expression forming on his face, though a flash of sharpness flickered in his eyes. Three years—this Inner Disciple Senior Fellow had never stopped investigating him. Her appearance here meant his layout had a flaw—but it also meant, the opportunity had arrived.

dialogue.content: "Senior Sister Su... why are you here?" Chen Ji stepped back half a pace, his voice carrying恰到好处的惊惶: "This is the deep ruins, it's very dangerous here, you'd better leave quickly..."

text.content: Su Qingyao ignored his performance, walking straight to stop three feet in front of him. Her gaze fell on the faintly glowing fragment on Chen Ji's chest, a flash of understanding flickering in her eyes.

dialogue.content: "No need to pretend, Chen Ji." Her voice was cold as ice. "You think I don't know? The Tianji Record's resonance, within a hundred li, I can sense it all. You think I've only been investigating you these three years?" She slightly raised her chin: "I've been waiting for you to come to me."

choice.prompt: Facing Su Qingyao's pressing approach, Chen Ji needed to make a choice: continue feigning ignorance to probe her cards, or reveal part of his strength to intimidate the other party?

choices.description: Maintain the useless persona, use an even more exaggerated timid posture to test her patience limit, see what information she will reveal.
choices.risk_hint: She Has Already Suspected, Continuing the Act May Backfire

text.content: Chen Ji thudded to his knees, trembling all over like a sieve: "Senior Sister Su, spare my life! I really don't know anything! That glowing thing is... it's scrap metal I picked from a trash heap..."

choices.description: Acknowledge having secrets, but only reveal part, use ambiguous leverage to exchange for her true intentions.
choices.risk_hint: May Fall Right Into Her Trap

text.content: Chen Ji slowly stood up, the timidity on his face receding like a tide, replaced by an abyssal calm: "Senior Sister Su, we're both smart people. Why not speak frankly—what exactly do you want?"

Su Qingyao's eyes flickered slightly, clearly not expecting him to so straightforwardly shed his disguise. After a moment of silence, she took an ancient token from her怀中, its engraved patterns matching the Tianji Record Fragment on Chen Ji's chest like no other.

dialogue.content: "Do you know why the Tianji Record chose you?" Su Qingyao's voice softened slightly. "Because with every generation of Tianji Record master, there will be a 'Guide'. This is recorded in ancient texts as a secret—and I am the one chosen by the Tianji Record to find the fourth page."

text.content: Chen Ji's heart skipped a beat. Guide? This term had left a vague impression in Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul memories, but he had never thought deeply about it. If what Su Qingyao said was true, then her three years of investigating him wasn't merely out of suspicion or curiosity—but rather, a kind of fated guidance.

dialogue.content: "You don't believe me?" Su Qingyao seemed to have anticipated his silence, a meaningful curve appearing at the corner of her lips: "Then do you know why I could get infinitely close to the truth three times, yet be resolved by you each time?" She paused: "Because the Tianji Record doesn't allow the Guide to uncover the master's secrets too early—it protects you, and it protects me."

text.content: Chen Ji narrowed his eyes, calculating rapidly in his heart. This speech seemed frank, yet was full of holes—if she truly was a Guide, why not directly confront him instead of investigating for three years? There must be something here she hadn't said. But he had to admit, the claim about the Tianji Record protecting both parties could恰好解释 his confusion.

choice.prompt: Su Qingyao's revelation left Chen Ji deep in thought. He could choose to continue probing her cards, or proactively reveal information he possessed to exchange for greater trust.

choices.description: Since she mentioned the Guide, follow up to ask about her family background and true purpose, see how much she is willing to reveal.

dialogue.content: "Guide?" Chen Ji approached slowly, his gaze sharp as a blade: "Senior Sister Su, you still haven't answered my question—who exactly are you? Merely an Inner Disciple Senior Fellow probably can't access the secrets of the Tianji Record, right?"

choices.description: Proactively mention Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul, using it as leverage to test whether she knows more about the Tianji Record's internal mechanisms.
choices.risk_hint: Mo Xiansheng May Not Want Her to Know

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath, making a risky decision: "Alright, since Senior Sister Su has been frank, I won't hide anything. Within this Tianji Record, there exists a self-proclaimed Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul—he says the Tianji Record chose me because I am the 'Chosen One'."

Upon hearing this, a flash of astonishment crossed Su Qingyao's eyes, soon replaced by even deeper complex emotions. She fell silent for a long while before finally speaking, her voice carrying a barely perceptible tremor:

dialogue.content: "Mo Xiansheng... he's still there." Su Qingyao closed her eyes, seemingly digesting this information. "Then I have no reason to hide anything from you, Chen Ji. What I'm about to say may be very difficult for you to accept—but it concerns the fates of us both." She opened her eyes, her gaze fixed directly on Chen Ji: "I am a descendant of the First Prophet."

text.content: This sentence was like a thunderclap, exploding in Chen Ji's mind. The First Prophet—that was the original author of the Tianji Record, the source of all prophetic bloodlines. If Su Qingyao spoke truth, then her connection to the Tianji Record was far deeper than he imagined—this was no coincidence, but a causal entanglement spanning ten thousand years.

dialogue.content: "You don't need to doubt." Su Qingyao seemed to see through his shock. "My blood carries the inheritance of the First Prophet, which is why the Tianji Record chose me as the Guide. But this is only one reason—" she paused, a vulnerability appearing in her gaze that had never been shown before: "The other reason, is your mother."

text.content: Chen Ji froze entirely. Mother? His mother had disappeared when he was five years old, and everyone in the sect said she died in an accident. He had investigated countless times, yet never found any clues. And now, Su Qingyao was telling him that his mother was connected to all this?

choice.prompt: As the truth about his mother was about to be revealed, Chen Ji could choose how to face this information that might overturn his understanding.

choices.description: Despite the turmoil within, Chen Ji chose to first clarify all details, not letting emotions affect his judgment.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji's fingers trembled slightly, but he forcibly suppressed the surging emotions: "Senior Sister Su, please speak. What did my mother... what did she know?" His voice was terrifyingly calm, only his whitened knuckles betraying the turbulence within.

choices.description: Before Su Qingyao, shed part of his disguise, revealing genuine longing for his mother—this might exchange for her complete trust.

text.content: Chen Ji's defenses cracked at this moment. He remembered his mother's last night before she left, her gentle yet sorrowful gaze, and her words: "When the time comes, everything will become clear." Fifteen years—had he finally arrived at this "time"?

Su Qingyao watched his expression of intense suppression, a flicker of heartache crossing her eyes. She took a broken jade pendant from her sleeve, though shattered, it emanated a faint warm luster—Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply, that luster was too familiar, it was the unique aura of his mother's always-worn object.

dialogue.content: "This is what your mother asked me to pass on to you." Su Qingyao's voice became much softer. "Before she disappeared, she found something left by my ancestors—a letter spanning through time. She said, on the day you truly begin using the Tianji Record, I should give you this jade pendant."

text.content: Chen Ji trembled as he took the jade pendant, the warmth in his hands seemingly still retaining his mother's body temperature. He turned the pendant over, on its back were two ancient, simple characters—"Ji'er". In that instant, the cold mask he had maintained for fifteen years finally cracked.

dialogue.content: "Your mother..." Su Qingyao's voice suddenly became somewhat labored: "She didn't die in an accident, but chose to disappear actively to protect you. She knew the Tianji Record had chosen you, and she knew that once discovered by the old Sect Master and others, your fate would be only one—death."

text.content: Su Qingyao watched his slightly trembling back, an indescribable emotion welling up in her heart. This man before her, seemingly cowardly on the outside yet actually calculating without fail, had deceived everyone—but at this moment, he was merely a child who had lost his mother for fifteen years. Her own defenses, at this moment, quietly loosened by a fraction.

dialogue.content: "I don't know what else she wrote in the letter, because that part was sealed by the Tianji Record's aura." Su Qingyao said softly: "But I know, she has been watching you from somewhere. Otherwise, the Tianji Record wouldn't have chosen you—you are the 'Heavenly Fate Child' she traded her life for."
